stories.headline: Anthropic Reportedly Surpasses OpenAI as Most Valuable AI Startup
stories.summary: According to reports, Anthropic has become the world's most valuable AI startup, overtaking OpenAI in valuation [1]. The news has generated significant discussion in the tech community.
key_points: Marks a major shift in the competitive AI landscape
Generated substantial community discussion with 400+ points on Hacker News
stories.impact: This valuation milestone positions Anthropic as the market leader and could influence funding, talent acquisition, and strategic partnerships across the AI industry.

stories.headline: Pin Claude Code sessions to keep them alive during idle periods
stories.summary: Pinned sessions in Claude Code now persist even when not actively used and are only terminated under memory pressure after non-pinned sessions are closed first. This prevents losing your work context during breaks or when switching between tasks.
actionable_steps: Open Claude Code and start an agents session
Press Ctrl+T to pin the current session
The session will now remain active even during idle periods

stories.headline: Use _meta annotation to prevent large MCP tool results from being truncated
stories.summary: Claude Code now supports preserving large tool results (like database schemas) up to 500K characters by adding a special metadata annotation. This prevents important data from being cut off during processing.
actionable_steps: Add `_meta["anthropic/maxResultSizeChars"]` annotation to your MCP tool result
Set the value to your desired character limit (up to 500,000)
Test with large results like database schemas to verify they pass through completely

stories.headline: Enable forked subagents in external Claude Code builds
stories.summary: Forked subagents allow Claude Code to spawn separate agent processes for parallel task execution. This can improve performance for complex workflows that benefit from concurrent processing.
actionable_steps: Restart Claude Code to apply the setting
Verify subagents are working by checking for multiple agent processes during complex tasks

stories.headline: Enable Amazon Bedrock support with Mantle integration
stories.summary: Claude Code v2.1.94 added support for Amazon Bedrock through Mantle integration. This allows you to use Claude Code with Amazon's Bedrock service instead of the default API endpoints, potentially offering better performance or compliance for enterprise users.
actionable_steps: Set the environment variable CLAUDE_CODE_USE_MANTLE=1 in your system or terminal
Restart Claude Code to apply the new configuration
Verify the connection is working by running a test query

stories.headline: Use /usage command to track Claude Code resource consumption by category
stories.summary: The /usage command now provides detailed breakdowns of what's consuming your usage limits, including skills, subagents, plugins, and MCP server costs. This helps identify which features are driving your resource consumption for better optimization.
actionable_steps: Review the per-category breakdown showing skills, subagents, plugins, and MCP-server costs
Identify high-usage categories to optimize your workflow
